goal: Execute the actual fixed upstream computation and obtain real host program events to verify six-slot ownership/dependencies. Do not claim accelerator cycles, DMA overlap or IOMMU performance.
files_proposed: host-functional.c (private derived C program, exact upstream double_buf_mm structure plus labeled CPU shims and observation points)
parameters: Original default width=height256, stripe_height16, n_stripes16, six16384-byte slots,8OpenMPthreads. No intensity/phase sweep.
C_construction: Copy actual double_buf_mm lines44–276 into a private derived source file with source provenance and Apache2.0 notice. Keep allocation count, index switches, for nests, arithmetic, manager-thread assignments and all original waits/barriers.

Erase __host/__device address-space annotations only in the private host translation unit. Include omp.h, stdint.h, libc and local hero_dma_job_t definition. Do not compile/link original target MMIO code or activate target offload.

Provide explicitly labeled malloc/free scratchpad shims with six allocation roles in original A0/A1/B0/B1/C0/C1 order. Neither pretend host malloc is PULP scratchpad nor call the original NULL-returning allocator.

Provide synchronous CPU memcpy shims implementing existing upstream API signatures. Return a unique job ID after copy completes; wait validates and acknowledges exactly once. Blocking dev2host uses the same copy plus completion path, documenting that this is CPU behavior.

Immediately after original barrier208, add omp single with its implicit barrier to record compute_start(s,t,currentA/B/C slot and generations). Immediately after original omp-for228 implicit completion barrier, add omp single to record compute_done and the Ctile checksum. These are explicit extra observation/synchronization costs and cannot be timed as the original target.

Initialize default A/B exactly as original lines320–325. Run actual double_buf_mm with the source default. Independently run original host-reference inner loop335–346 and compare every output, plus expected2A for the default diagonal input. Propagate return errors.
Write events and all final output values plus metadata to local private artifacts; no production source, ABI, RTL or DMA run.
validator_acceptance: Exactly A16input, B256input, C16output copies, each16384bytes; total4,718,592bytes; Bwrap and all source/destination offsets match the pinned loops.

Exactly256 compute start/donepairs in(s,t) order; each performs65,536uint32multiply-addsteps by retained source code. All65,536outputs agree with the independently copied host reference and exact expected2A.

Compute start sees A_s/B(s,t) copy complete for its generation; previous compute done; C_s has either initial ownership or D(s-2) copy complete. A_s remains owned until K(s,15)done; B_q remains owned until K_qdone.

A(s+2)slot overwrite occurs after last K(s,15)read/compute completion; B(q+2)overwrite after K_qdone; C(s+2)writes after D_scopydone. Source-equivalent ownership is conservatively derived from complete compute calls, not a claimed earlier last-read.
Output copy reads C_s only after all16tilesdone, writes separate C main buffer, and application complete follows D15copydone and all other output completions.
Job waits refer to the requesting manager thread and are acknowledged exactly once; inspect source final blocking-copy semantics in the private shim.
Fixed commit/source hash still match manifest; no phase/intensity changes or omitted B reloads; traces clearly label CPU memcpy order and HOST times.
uncertainties_and_limits: Stock upstream complete host fallback is not runnable as-is because actual host hero_l1malloc returnsNULL. A private clearly labeled shim is therefore an adaptation.

CPU memcpy is synchronous: events can verify real source execution and buffer ownership but do not establish the original asyncDMA schedule, transfer backpressure, AXIBcompletion or target-cycle durations.
Observation omp-single barriers change scheduling/cost. Use this run for functional ownership only, not performance.
Original active offload path is copy-based and SVM path if0; applying this kernel to current shared-IOMMU test remains a separate source-derived workflow adaptation.
A practical next G0 must decide one/two/three victimDMAstreams, six-slot memory, real compute cost and cache/data coherence; no placeholder compute cycle should be selected for gain.
negative_checks_if_implemented: Reject a changed slotgeneration before ownerrelease
